errors.text: The proposed 1–10 micrometer grain-size range is poorly compatible with the target's approximately 21 Å-thick coating and is not justified for this nanoscale geometry.
The hypothesis extrapolates room-temperature evidence from a different, bulk CoCrFeMnNi alloy to FeNiCrCoCu/Cu across varied temperatures without supporting evidence.
The experiment provides an outcome rejection rule but no clear rejection criterion for the proposed Hall–Petch mechanism.
